name: test_successful_logout_from_application[chromium]
description:
Test: Successful logout from application
        Type: Positive
        Preconditions: User is logged in and on any page of the application
        Steps:
          1. Click the logout link/menu option
          Expected: System redirects to login page and user session is terminated
